envelope.reason: a note may now block a concept, so the notebook stands on the design whose concepts it names
envelope.cause: the amendment just made to notebook's gloss

payload.gloss: the set of notes: ideas, questions and decisions not yet canonical, the intake that design canonizes. Anyone may capture, revise or retract a note. A note's title is its name, one live note per title. Its kind is one of the note skill's labels (idea, question, decision), which the runtime never interprets. A live note that blocks a plan, a unit or a concept is an **owed ruling**, the one sense of that sign; it blocks what it names until it no longer does, by being retracted or revised to block nothing, and a diverged note blocks whatever any of its versions blocks until it is reconciled. A note blocking a plan or unit holds its work. A note blocking a concept holds a design finding not yet folded into the design: it refuses binding any plan, and adding any unit, whose concepts' closure contains that concept, and never holds a unit already authored, so the work in flight runs on while the finding waits for the design's next amendment.
